- Validate input: if n <= 2 return [] since primes start at 2; handle n as non-negative integer.
- Generate all primes less than n using a sieve (Sieve of Eratosthenes): create boolean array up to n-1, mark composites starting from p*p for each p up to sqrt(n), collect indices marked prime starting from 2.
- Return the list of primes found (ensuring strictly less than n), matching examples.
